name: photo-abstract-editorial
title_zh: 把一张照片变成克制的美学双联档案
tagline_zh: 不重绘、不风格化，原图原样保留；旁边生成一张从照片里抽象出的记忆面板，配一句英文诗题。适合做展览级归档海报。
tagline_en: Keeps your photo untouched, adds a photo-derived abstract memory panel and a poetic English title. Archival-grade.
desc_en: Create a clean, vertical editorial artwork that preserves an uploaded photograph as the original image and pairs it with a restrained, photo-derived abstract memory panel and poetic English title. Use when asked to transform a photo into an abstract editorial diptych, photo-plus-abstraction composition, visual memory panel, or minimalist archival poster without redrawing or stylizing the source ph
why_zh: 抽象面板的色块与构图直接从原图像素里提取，不是随机生成——所以它和原照片有可追溯的视觉血缘。
why_en: The abstract panel's palette and geometry are derived from the source pixels, not random—so it shares a traceable visual lineage.
limit_zh: 只接受单张竖幅照片；输出为双联构图，不做多图拼贴。抽象面板仅提取色彩与大致明暗分布，不识别语义内容（如人脸、物体）。
limit_en: Single vertical photo only; output is a diptych, no collages. Abstraction extracts color and tone only, no semantic recognition (faces/objects).
title_en: Turn one photo into a restrained editorial diptych
